title: Radical-Species Conformance and Golden Proof
objective: Run the common species contract against eight radically different species fixtures and close all remaining semantic gaps.
acceptance: all eight fixtures pass the common conformance matrix
no species-name conditional is needed for core workflows
boundaries: MVPS-16 owns final cross-contract conformance/golden proof for the MVPS program and may close only semantic gaps required by that proof.

The same common contracts must cover ordinary human, winged humanoid, aquatic non-humanoid, centaur-like quadruped, construct/android, multi-form shapeshifter, incorporeal being and a radically alien body plan.

Golden proof must exercise creation/selection, validation, runtime projection, equipment compatibility, environment interaction, optional progression, transformation where applicable, serialization/import-export/migration, authoring/inspection/presentation and NPC/Creature reuse.
No core proof path may branch on species name or identity; differences must resolve through typed canonical data, owner contracts and explicit capability/morphology/form references.
Shared Character/Ability/Equipment/Environment/Progression/Knowledge/Presentation/NPC-Creature owner authority remains unchanged; MVPS-16 may prove integration but not absorb those engines.
Any unresolved late-bound owner dependency needed for final proof must be surfaced as a real blocker rather than replaced by invented semantics.
MVPS-16 is the terminal planned MVPS work item; program completion may be selected only after its golden proof is completed_verified.
